inventoryScope: PLATFORM_TOOLS entries in platform-tools.ts that expose /api/agent/read/* routes. Other custom MCP tools and non-platform route families are outside this generated inventory.

summary.organizationRoleProofCoverage: source_audited_all_14: ten sensitive reads require dashboard_viewer/auditor grants or live owner/admin checks; three category/org-profile/leaderboard reads are public; one owned-organization read is bound to the authenticated owner; deployment/runtime is not audited

authorityNotes.identity: Inputs and scopes are inventoried from the MCP registry; actual principal binding and per-resource role checks must be verified in the gateway and server handler.
authorityNotes.readDependencies: The server dispatcher and downstream fullnode, indexer, social-server, messaging, automation, and AI-credit dependencies are not inferred as authoritative from route names.
authorityNotes.builders: GET query tools do not construct transactions. Mutating actions and their builders are tracked in myso-agents-current-action-coverage.json.
authorityNotes.effectVerification: Receipt-named reads require action-specific fullnode verification; ordinary list/detail reads are snapshots and do not prove finalized effects or live authority.
authorityNotes.deploymentGate: Feature flags, package IDs, service credentials, network compatibility, and hosted adapters remain per-tool gates and require a separate config audit.
